name: youtube-tv
description: YouTube TV interface as a Firefox extension

scripts.package: node build.mjs && web-ext build -s dist -a artifacts --overwrite-dest
scripts.sign: npm run build && npm run source-zip && web-ext sign -s dist -a artifacts --channel=unlisted --upload-source-code artifacts/source.zip
scripts.source-zip: rm -f artifacts/source.zip && mkdir -p artifacts && zip -qr artifacts/source.zip src dev static test build.mjs package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json README.md BUILD.md
